149 |     //====================================== WITHDRAW ========================================//
   150 | 
   151 |     // Members to withdraw
   152 |     function withdraw(address synth, uint basisPoints) external returns(uint redeemedAmount) {
   153 |         redeemedAmount = _processWithdraw(synth, msg.sender, basisPoints);          // Get amount to withdraw
   154 |         sendFunds(synth, msg.sender, redeemedAmount);
   155 |     }
   156 |     function _processWithdraw(address _synth, address _member, uint _basisPoints) internal returns(uint redeemedAmount) {
   157 |         require((block.timestamp - mapMemberSynth_lastTime[_member][_synth]) >= minimumDepositTime, "DepositTime");    // stops attacks
   158 |         redeemedAmount = iUTILS(UTILS()).calcPart(_basisPoints, mapMemberSynth_deposit[_member][_synth]); // Share of deposits
   159 |         mapMemberSynth_deposit[_member][_synth] -= redeemedAmount;                  // Reduce for member                             
   160 |         uint _weight = iUTILS(UTILS()).calcPart(_basisPoints, mapMember_weight[_member]);   // Find recorded weight to reduce
   161 |         mapMember_weight[_member] -= _weight;                                   // Reduce for member 
   162 |         totalWeight -= _weight;                                                 // Reduce for total
   163 |         emit MemberWithdraws(_synth, _member, redeemedAmount, _weight, totalWeight);   // Event
   164 |     }
   165 |
